mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP growth) over the past 6 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-month window, or 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate exceeds 2.0% for the first time in a month, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are expected to be negative due to anticipated rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during tightening periods, or FEDFUNDS stays above 2.0% for more than 30 days without a correction.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% in the same month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as both indicators signal expansionary conditions.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and UNRATE rise by >2% from their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the co-movement, or the rise in UNRATE exceeds 4.5% while GDPC1 growth stalls.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion phase (characterized by decelerating GDP growth and rising CPIAUCSL), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days are expected to be negative as investors anticipate peak growth and potential corrections.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate declines below 2% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% for the past month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in late-cycle periods, or GDP growth remains above 2% while CPIAUCSL stays below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (industrial production index) above its 12-month average predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as strong supply signals robust economic activity.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained INDPRO growth, or the increase is not above the 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: When the UNRATE falls below 4.0% for the first time in a month, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days are expected to be positive as improved labor market conditions boost market sentiment.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of UNRATE below 4.0%, or the rate remains above 4.0% for multiple months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of FEDFUNDS below 1.5% and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 3% in the same month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as accommodative monetary policy fuels demand.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.5% and GDPC1 > 3% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the conditions, or FEDFUNDS rises above 1.5% while GDPC1 growth remains below 3%.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (characterized by GDPC1 growth below 2% and UNRATE above 6%), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days are expected to be negative as market anticipates economic slowdown and potential corrections.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 2% and UNRATE > 6% for the past month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during recessionary periods, or GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% while UNRATE remains above 6%.
